ui_bugs.issue: Uncaught Error 'RNTextInput.default.State.currentlyFocusedInput is not a function' thrown from node_modules/@gorhom/bottom-sheet/lib/module/components/bottomSheetTextInput/BottomSheetTextInput.js:37:66 when the input receives blur/focus events on react-native-web. Latest RNW removed TextInput.State.currentlyFocusedInput (replaced by document.activeElement / currentlyFocusedField). Consequence: after typing in notes-input or passenger-label-input, the app crashes → add-to-cart-button click no longer creates a cart-item-0. The single-order 'confirm-ride-button' path still works because it happens before the crash, but the cart & subsequent options interactions are blocked.

During heavy passenger interaction we also observed one HTTP 429 response from the backend — worth confirming there is no aggressive rate-limit on /api/rides/estimate that could hit normal users when toggling options.

rca_of_issue: Root cause of the cart crash: @gorhom/bottom-sheet's BottomSheetTextInput imports react-native's TextInput and, on blur, calls TextInput.State.currentlyFocusedInput() to decide whether to blur the underlying native input. Recent react-native-web versions removed the deprecated TextInput.State API (kept only in RN core). On web the property is undefined → TypeError, which becomes an Uncaught Error that unmounts the RideOptions bottom sheet before the add-to-cart onPress handler runs, so no cart entry is created. Reproduction: passenger home → tap pickup-chip → pick CDG → pick Tour Eiffel → in options bottom sheet, type any character in 'notes-input' or 'passenger-label-input' → click outside → red error banner. Fix (minimal): polyfill TextInput.State.currentlyFocusedInput = () => document.activeElement at app boot for web only. Long-term: upgrade @gorhom/bottom-sheet to a version that no longer relies on the removed API, or swap BottomSheetTextInput for a plain TextInput inside the sheet.
